exp_4.608.description: v3-preprocessing (fixed threshold=0.4) replication of exp_608: same settings (beta=0.5, 120 epochs), new dataset (glioma-preproc-3.h5), full retrain -- nothing transferred
exp_4.608.notes: New preprocessing pipeline (v3): fixed max-intensity threshold (0.4) replacing v2's adaptive mask, same automated spirit. Confirmed v1's current default dataset already corresponds to threshold=0.6 (strong_signal_mask.npy provenance). Policy: GPU-only Modal jobs (CVAE/CNN); CPU-parallel MIL work (mi-SVM, etc.) stays local for this experiment family.
